svg.title: HITL FlatSat wiring: power distribution, CAN bus and the signal harnesses between the four Raspberry Pi Pico 2 boards, labelled with the harness numbers of hardware/WIRING.md
svg.text: CAN bus, 500 kbit/s: CAN-H and CAN-L, twisted together (ICD 6.1)
side by side on the dual expander
GP16, GP17: PWM to the motor driver
RUN: held low by the EPS node
GP8, GP9: I2C to the rail monitors
GP16: switch 0, the ADCS node's RUN
Not drawn: ground (black), one common ground with its star point at the battery (P8), and the breakouts' 3.3 V supplies from their Pico (E2, O3). Tags are the harness numbers in hardware/WIRING.md.
